title: On the approximation of permutons
summary: We study the optimal rectangular-discrepancy approximation of permutons by finite permutations. We transfer bounds from discrepancy theory to this more restricted setup. Moreover, we show that superlinear approximation can occur only for permutons supported by graphs of measure-preserving functions, and demonstrate how the local regularity of this function obstructs approximability. We also consider the biased Brownian separable permuton and prove a lower bound on its approximation error by showing that its supporting measure-preserving function has Lipschitz points almost surely.
